title: Cruise control · Level 3: The payload
brief: A straight lane 3000 x 400 mm between two red no-go strips. Hold 200 mm/s along the lane for 10 s with dc() only (no DriveBase, no run(), drive() or other controlled move on motors 1-2). The course measures the robot's true forward speed along the lane every 10 ms from 1.00 s to 9.00 s after Run, both included (801 samples), and scores each run max(0, 100 - 2 x MAE), MAE the mean |v - 200| in mm/s. A run that puts a wheel on a red strip, calls a controlled move or ends before 9.00 s scores 0 and does not finish. Starts vary by +-30 mm and +-2 deg. At a moment drawn per run between 3.00 and 6.00 s (a whole 10 ms, not told to the program) a 300 g payload lands on the robot at once (from 0 to 300 g): hold the speed through it. The class robot, fixed. Par: MAE 12 mm/s. Pass: a mean of at least 60 over the 10 runs with at least 8 finished.

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.sampled & r.moveTicks == 0 & r.noGoEntries == 0)
